description: This file defines the 'Menu' controller class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform administration panel. It handles rendering the menu management interface, processing CRUD operations for menu items, and generating menu lists with hierarchical structures for the admin UI.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A controller class managing the admin interface for CRUD operations on menu items, including rendering forms, listing existing menus hierarchically, and handling save/delete requests.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main menu management page, including header, footer, and menu list.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Calls getList to generate and return the menu list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves menu items from the database, structures them hierarchically, and renders the menu list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the menu item creation/edit form, pre-filling data if editing an existing menu.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions to create or update a menu item, validating permissions and data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected menu items after permission check.
